title: Vision: A Computational Investigation into the Human Representation and Processing of Visual Information
author: David Marr
note: The main body develops specialist computational representations and methods for image structure, stereopsis, surface reconstruction and shape recognition. The philosophical introduction is influential, but it does not change the main technical purpose. Publisher contents and the original text's image-representation section were inspected. H3 applies before scoring; prestige and accessible introductory ideas do not override it.
